maxHistoryItems.description: Maximum number of recent history rows to keep. Use 0 to keep all rows for the current run.

showStats.description: Show compact model/tool/failure/update counters in the status card.

showActiveTools.description: Show currently running tool calls while they are active.

showDetailPanel.description: Render recent history in a native Feishu collapsible detail panel.

detailPanelExpanded.description: Open the detail panel by default instead of starting collapsed.

stuckThresholdMs.description: Mark active tools as possibly stuck after this many milliseconds.

stuckCheckIntervalMs.description: Refresh active-tool elapsed time and stuck status at this interval.

showFinalSummary.description: Show a compact completion summary when the agent run ends.
